ranking_definitions.S1: sort by S1 desc, tie-break S2 desc, then trial_id asc (DEFAULT)
ranking_definitions.S2: sort by S2 desc, tie-break S1 desc, then trial_id asc

score_definitions.S1: 100 - empty cells (asserted equal to env.occupied every trial)
score_definitions.S2: S1 / attempts; attempts = env.placements_count (accepted placements; every attempt is legal)

definitions.piece: piece type id A..P; oriented variant = (type, canonical rotation)
definitions.combination: unordered multiset of piece types among one trial's placements
definitions.connected_combination: same, but the pieces form an edge-connected group (4-neighbour contact); oriented variant is translation-normalised ((type,rotation,dx,dy)...) as in Expt-17
definitions.counting: each key counted once per trial
definitions.winning_flag: n_top >= 25 and lift_vs_bottom > 1.0 and two-proportion z >= 1.96 (or absent from bottom with n_top >= 25)
